[1] quorum-loss-distributed-system.md > Symptoms (score 0.2554)
A stateful system (database cluster, coordination service, object store index,
message broker) reports that it is below quorum, has lost its leader, is
read-only, or has entered a recovery or safe mode. Reads may partially succeed
from cache or replicas; writes fail. Recovery is often slow because the system
must rebuild or re-replicate state.

[4] memory-leak-and-oom.md > Mitigation (score 0.2025)
Restart to buy time, then fix the retention: bound and evict caches, close
resources in finally blocks, add backpressure to queues. Right-size the memory
limit only after the leak is ruled out.

[5] memory-leak-and-oom.md > Symptoms (score 0.1891)
Memory use climbs steadily over minutes or hours rather than tracking load.
Eventually instances are killed and restarted (OOM), latency rises from garbage
collection pressure before the kill, and the pattern repeats on a sawtooth as
instances cycle.
